items.question: Do I need a WhatsApp Business number?
items.answer: Only for WhatsApp campaigns. Event messages, the push reminder, announcements, follower updates and personal messages work without one. To connect one, you link your own WhatsApp Business number through Meta once, which takes about 20 minutes with our help, and Meta approves your message templates.

items.question: Does {{brand.name}} send messages for me?
items.answer: Yes: confirmations, changes, cancellations and a feedback request go out for every booking, and guests on the {{brand.name}} app get a push reminder 15 minutes before the start.

items.question: How many people can an announcement reach?
items.answer: Up to 500 people booked on, or interested in, one event, as a notification.

items.question: Who pays for WhatsApp messages?
items.answer: Meta charges for business-started WhatsApp conversations, billed to your WhatsApp Business account at its rates.

items.question: Can I message people I imported from a spreadsheet?
items.answer: Campaigns only go to people who opted in to hear from you on WhatsApp, so ask them first. You can always send a personal message from your own phone.

items.question: Can guests reply?
items.answer: To campaigns, yes: replies land in your {{brand.name}} inbox and you can answer while WhatsApp’s reply window is open. Announcements are one-way notifications.
